<?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
if ( class_exists( 'WC_Product_Simple' ) ) {
  $items = array( array( 'Aurora Designer Chair', '299' ), array( 'Smart Table Lamp', '79' ), array( 'Ceramic Vase Set', '49' ) );
  foreach ( $items as $it ) {
    $p = new WC_Product_Simple();
    $p->set_name( $it[0] );
    $p->set_status( 'publish' );
    $p->set_catalog_visibility( 'visible' );
    $p->set_regular_price( $it[1] );
    $p->set_stock_status( 'instock' );
    $p->save();
  }
}
$page_id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'My Wishlist', 'post_content' => '[wishlist]' ) );
$s = get_option( 'wun_settings', array() );
$s['show_on_loop'] = true;
$s['kip_style_enabled'] = true;
$s['kip_preset'] = 'soft';
$s['kip_accent'] = '#f0834e';
$s['kip_layout'] = 'grid';
$s['button_style'] = 'icon';
$s['page_id'] = $page_id;
update_option( 'wun_settings', $s );
